usedFor: When a Lulu print job changes status, one person gets a Slack direct message.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Print Job Status” in Lulu, then “Send Direct Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The trigger is pushed on each Lulu status change, so the orderer hears at once.

watchOut: “Create and Submit Print Order” ships real books, so a casual Slack channel message could place one.
